separation.promotion_rule: No harvest finding, protocol proposal, donor test or research P0 row promotes implementation, executable route, grant or live verification.

discovery.purpose: First match AION's present/future engineering needs to truthful in-house state; categorize external findings as methodological/test intelligence or selective protocol-contract research. Do NOT implement, import or rank donor code as a default.
discovery.selection_policy: Categorize coverage and evidence before judging approaches; no automatic adoption or runtime route selection.
discovery.gate_policy: Harvest discovery supports I0/P2/P3/P4 and future R5; no harvest assignment is a blocker. Roadmap remains a reference for mapping needs, not authorization to code during discovery.
